en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modest modernist institutional building in a rural setting. The light‑colored, two‑storey structure with a tiled gable roof and several chimneys is surrounded by lawns, paths and trees. A large tree stands in front of the main entrance, and exterior staircases lead to side doors and balconies. The foreground shows a gravel yard and landscaped garden. Text printed at the bottom left identifies the place as 'Gamleby Sjukhem', and text at the bottom right credits the photographer and publisher.
